title: Enhancing intraoperative tumor delineation with multispectral short-wave infrared fluorescence imaging and machine learning
summary: In a preclinical neuroblastoma mouse model, tumor-region classification against manually drawn regions reached 97.5% per-pixel accuracy. The cohort is small and preclinical; validation against human histopathologic tumor margins remains unestablished.
ai_technology: Machine learning classifies multispectral short-wave-infrared fluorescence images to delineate tumor tissue.
organization: University College London, Wellcome, EPSRC Centre for Interventional and Surgical Sciences, London, United Kingdom
